features.name: CameraAdvancedCapture
features.note: Faithful near-verbatim port. Every UWP control is present in the WinUI live UIA tree with matching name/text/geometry: PreviewControl (CaptureElement -> MediaPlayerElement), CycleModeButton (+ ModeTextBlock 'Standard'), PhotoButton, 'HDR Analyzer:' label, HdrImpactBar (ProgressBar), SceneTypeTextBlock. Both apps settle into the same no-camera state: blank preview, both buttons disabled, HDR bar empty -> no control responded in UWP, so no behavioral regression. The WinUI candidate screenshot captured near-blank (WinUI 3 swapchain/PrintWindow capture limitation), but the UIA tree confirms full content is laid out and rendered; visual parity verified structurally rather than by pixels.
